action: Baseline run with GBS=32, MBS=2, FP8=hybrid, 8xMI355X
lesson: Baseline ms/iter ~1700ms with GBS=32, EP=1, FP8 hybrid. 15 iters + eval takes ~176s total. Loss trajectory: 11.85 -> 9.82 over 15 iters. Eval loss ~9.75 after 15 iters (target is 3.34).
context: First trial run inside container. PRIMUS_TRAIN_ITERS=15, PRIMUS_EVAL_INTERVAL=10000. Symlinks to /workspace/code, /data, /model, /results.

moe_permute_fusion is already enabled by default in GPT-OSS-20B config. No need to test separately. Primus applies 16 patches at startup including permute_fusion_patches.

lesson: gradient_accumulation_fusion is already enabled by default. Fuses wgrad GEMM with optimizer accumulation.

MLPerf uses :::MLLOG JSON lines. Key events: cache_clear, init_start/stop, run_start/stop, epoch_start/stop, block_start/stop, train_loss (per-iter with samples_count and lr), eval_loss, train_samples. ms/iter derived from consecutive train_loss timestamps. Run status is 'success' or 'aborted' in run_stop metadata.

lesson: Marginal +0.2% gain from fused TopK router on MI355X 8xGPU EP=1. Numerically equivalent.
PrimusTurbo attention crashes with window_size=[128,0] SWA pattern. Do not use with SWA models.
Sync-free MoE -23.6% regression at EP=1. Only beneficial with EP>1 where AlltoAll comm exists.
PrimusTurbo grouped MLP -24.2% regression. Default legacy grouped GEMM already optimal for hipBLASLt.
GBS=64 12% slower throughput (17.2 vs 19.5 samp/s). GBS=32 optimal for MI355X 8-GPU.

action: MBS=4 GA=1 with GBS=32 on MI355X
lesson: MBS=4 OOM: 20B MoE uses 252GB/288GB at MBS=2. MBS=4 needs ~720MB more activation memory.

action: Kernel profile breakdown on MI355X 8-GPU EP=1
lesson: GEMM 54%, elementwise 11%, NCCL 10%, MoE dispatch 2.3%. GEMM-dominated limits software optimization.

action: Full Tier 3 convergence run with default config (GBS=32 LR=4e-4 FP8=hybrid)
lesson: TTT=11726.3s (195.4min), status=success, final_eval_loss=3.3324, ms_per_iter=1655.7. GBS=32 is optimal for 8xMI355X. Baseline config near-optimal with 16 eval checkpoints to converge.

Baseline config already near-optimal. No fusion flags, runtime tunables, or hyperparameter changes improved ms/iter or TTT. GBS=32 outperforms GBS=16 (61% higher throughput) and GBS=64 (33% higher throughput). LR=6e-4 gives marginal convergence improvement (+0.03 eval loss at 16K samples) but not enough to justify risk.
